chunk_id='FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DELIVERY' doc_type='STATUTE' title='Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) Equity Delivery' citation_uri='rag://statutory/finance_act_2024#FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DELIVERY' relevance_score=0.259 sanitized_snippet='<UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT id="FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DELIVERY" authority="Ministry of Finance, Government of India">
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) Equity Delivery
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Chapter VII — Securities Transaction Tax: Under Section 98 and Section 99, taxable securities transactions in Equity Delivery on recognized stock exchanges shall be levied at 0.1% (one-tenth of one percent) payable by both the purchaser and seller. For equity intraday (non-delivery) transactions, the statutory rate is 0.025% payable by the seller only. Statutory costs are mandatory and deduct from gross trading turnover before net trading realization.
</UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT>'

chunk_id='FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DERIVATIVES' doc_type='STATUTE' title='Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Revised STT on Futures and Options' citation_uri='rag://statutory/finance_act_2024#FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DERIVATIVES' relevance_score=0.234 sanitized_snippet='<UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT id="FINANCE-ACT-2024-STT-DERIVATIVES" authority="Ministry of Finance, Government of India">
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Revised STT on Futures and Options
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Section 98 Amendments effective October 1, 2024: 1. Sale of an option in securities: STT increased to 0.1% (from 0.0625%) of the option premium payable by seller. 2. Sale of a future in securities: STT increased to 0.02% (from 0.0125%) of the trade value payable by seller. Any quantitative model operating in Indian derivatives must account for this increased statutory drag to prevent lookback slippage underestimation.
</UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT>'

chunk_id='FINANCE-ACT-2024-CAPITAL-GAINS' doc_type='STATUTE' title='Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Capital Gains Restructuring (12.5% LTCG & 20% STCG)' citation_uri='rag://statutory/finance_act_2024#FINANCE-ACT-2024-CAPITAL-GAINS' relevance_score=0.214 sanitized_snippet='<UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT id="FINANCE-ACT-2024-CAPITAL-GAINS" authority="Ministry of Finance, Government of India">
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Capital Gains Restructuring (12.5% LTCG & 20% STCG)
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Chapter IV amendments to Section 112A and Section 111A of the Income-tax Act, 1961: 1. Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) on listed equity shares, equity-oriented units, and business trust units held > 12 months are taxed at 12.5% (increased from 10%) for transfers on or after July 23, 2024. The annual aggregate LTCG exemption limit under Section 112A was increased from INR 1,00,000 to INR 1,25,000. 2. Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) under Section 111A on listed equities held <= 12 months are taxed at 20% (increased from 15%). Indexation benefit on unlisted assets and real estate is rationalized to 12.5% without indexation.
</UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT>'

chunk_id='SEBI-LODR-REG30-MATERIALITY' doc_type='REGULATION' title='SEBI LODR Regulation 30: Disclosure of Material Events' citation_uri='rag://sebi/lodr_reg30#SEBI-LODR-REG30-MATERIALITY' relevance_score=0.195 sanitized_snippet='<UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT id="SEBI-LODR-REG30-MATERIALITY" authority="Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)">
SEBI LODR Regulation 30: Disclosure of Material Events
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 30: Every listed entity shall promptly make disclosures of any events or information which, in the opinion of the board of directors, are material. Material events under Schedule III Part A must be disclosed to recognized stock exchanges (NSE/BSE) as soon as reasonably possible and no later than: (a) thirty minutes from the closure of the board meeting for outcome disclosures; (b) twelve hours from occurrence for events originating within the entity; (c) twenty-four hours from occurrence for external events.
</UNTRUSTED_STATUTORY_DOCUMENT>'
